# Overview: scripted localisation for the Cortes panel.
# Party roles, the majority verdict, the chamber status and the government name are
# derived here from the country variables the Spanish campaign already keeps, so the
# panel never shows a raw variable or a single unset branch.
# Generated by tools/build_spain_cortes_hemicycle.py.

defined_text = {
	name = spain_cortes_role_socialists
	text = {
		trigger = { check_variable = { var = spain_government_party value = 5 } }
		localization_key = SPAIN_CORTES_ROLE_GOVERNMENT
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				check_variable = { var = spain_coalition_1 value = 5 }
				check_variable = { var = spain_coalition_2 value = 5 }
			}
		}
		localization_key = SPAIN_CORTES_ROLE_COALITION
	}
	text = { localization_key = SPAIN_CORTES_ROLE_OPPOSITION }
}

defined_text = {
	name = spain_cortes_government_text
	# one entry per party id the government variables can hold

	text = {
		trigger = { check_variable = { var = spain_government_party value = 5 } }
		localization_key = SPAIN_CORTES_BLOC_SOCIALISTS
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { check_variable = { var = spain_government_party value = 4 } }
		localization_key = SPAIN_CORTES_BLOC_REPUBLICANS
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { check_variable = { var = spain_government_party value = 2 } }
		localization_key = SPAIN_CORTES_BLOC_LIBERALS
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { check_variable = { var = spain_government_party value = 3 } }
		localization_key = SPAIN_CORTES_BLOC_CONSERVATIVES
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { check_variable = { var = spain_government_party value = 1 } }
		localization_key = SPAIN_CORTES_BLOC_MONARCHISTS
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { check_variable = { var = spain_government_party value = 6 } }
		localization_key = SPAIN_CORTES_BLOC_CARLISTS
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { check_variable = { var = spain_government_party value = 7 } }
		localization_key = SPAIN_CORTES_BLOC_FALANGE
	}
	text = { localization_key = SPAIN_CORTES_NO_GOVERNMENT }
}

defined_text = {
	name = spain_cortes_margin_text
	text = {
		trigger = { check_variable = { var = spain_government_majority value = 1 } }
		localization_key = SPAIN_CORTES_MARGIN_OVER
	}
	text = { localization_key = SPAIN_CORTES_MARGIN_SHORT }
}

defined_text = {
	name = spain_cortes_verdict_text
	text = {
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable = spain_government_party }
				check_variable = { var = spain_government_party value = 0 }
			}
		}
		localization_key = SPAIN_CORTES_VERDICT_NONE
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { check_variable = { var = spain_government_majority value = 1 } }
		localization_key = SPAIN_CORTES_VERDICT_PASS
	}
	text = { localization_key = SPAIN_CORTES_VERDICT_FAIL }
}

defined_text = {
	name = spain_cortes_status_text
	text = {
		trigger = { has_country_flag = spain_cortes_dissolved }
		localization_key = SPAIN_CORTES_STATUS_DISSOLVED
	}
	text = { localization_key = SPAIN_CORTES_STATUS_SITTING }
}
